std_spiro_s_quasi_kernel_conjecture.note: Authored in X16.v:spiro_quasi_kernel_half_covered_statement. Encodes Spiro's conjecture: every loopless digraph has a 2-kernel K such that at least half the vertices lie in K or have an in-neighbour in K.

std_stein_s_conjecture_on_oriented_paths.note: Authored in X17.v:stein_oriented_paths_strict_semidegree_statement. Encodes Stein's conjecture: every nonempty oriented graph with strict minimum semidegree greater than k/2 contains every orientation of the k-edge path.

std_sumner_s_conjecture.note: Authored in X17.v:sumner_oriented_tree_unavoidable_statement. Encodes Sumner's conjecture: every oriented tree of order n>1 is (2n-2)-unavoidable in tournaments.

std_thomason_s_conjecture_on_book_ramsey.note: Authored in X4.v:thomason_book_ramsey_bound_statement. Encodes the diagonal book Ramsey bound r(B_n^(k)) <= 2^k(n+k-2)+2 using the standard k-spine, n-page book graph.

std_tomescu_s_conjecture_maximum_number_.note: Authored in X254.v:tomescu_colouring_count_rooted_trees_statement. Tomescu, the wording with the extremal graphs K_k plus a tree rooted at each clique vertex: a synonym of tomescu_connected_colouring_count_statement (for connected G that wording is the 2-core being a k-clique, arXiv:1712.06067v3 TeX l.93). Proved before the pin (pinned status open; Fox, He and Manners).

Authored in X254.v:tomescu_colouring_count_rooted_trees_duplicate_statement. Tomescu, the same pinned text as the ..._k_colorin row: a synonym of tomescu_connected_colouring_count_statement. Proved before the pin (pinned status open; Fox, He and Manners, arXiv:1712.06067v3).

Authored in X254.v:tomescu_connected_colouring_count_statement. Tomescu (the canonical row of four): a connected graph G on n vertices with chi(G) = k >= 4 has P_G(k) <= k!(k-1)^(n-k) proper colourings with labelled colours, with equality iff the 2-core of G is a k-clique (x254_two_core). Proved before the pin (pinned status open): Fox, He and Manners, arXiv:1712.06067v3, Theorem 1 (TeX l.98-105).

Authored in X254.v:tomescu_colouring_count_two_core_duplicate_statement. Tomescu, the canonical text without its i.e. gloss: a synonym of tomescu_connected_colouring_count_statement. Proved before the pin (pinned status open; Fox, He and Manners, arXiv:1712.06067v3).

std_trotignon_vu_kovi_conjecture_isk4_tr.note: Authored in X254.v:isk4_triangle_free_three_colourable_statement. Trotignon and Vuskovic: a graph with no induced subdivision of K_4 and no triangle has chromatic number at most 3 (GTBase induced_subdivision, triangle_free). Proved before the pin (pinned status open): Chudnovsky, Liu, Schaudt, Spirkl, Trotignon and Vuskovic, arXiv:1704.08104v1, Conjecture 1 (TeX l.107-110) and l.114.

std_vizing_s_edge_colouring_kempe_equiva.note: Authored in X256.v:vizing_kempe_optimal_colouring_question_statement. Vizing's question (arXiv:2107.07900v1, Question 1.3): a synonym of X213's vizing_kempe_interchange_statement (bm:bm-060), both directions in the Notes. Solved before the pin (pinned status open), as X213 records (Narboni, arXiv:2302.12914v1).

std_wigderson_s_edge_deletion_ramsey_con.note: Authored in X240.v:edge_deletion_ramsey_constant_factor_statement. Wigderson's edge-deletion conjecture (arXiv:2208.11181v3 l.379-385, restated as open in the source arXiv:2311.01887v1 l.198; open as far as the sources show): r(G) <= C r(G - xy) for every graph G and edge xy (XE1 xe1_diagonal_ramsey_number, GTBase del_edge_set).

std_woodall_s_list_colouring_conjecture_.note: Authored in X12.v:woodall_ks_t_minor_free_list_colouring_statement. Encodes Woodall's list-colouring conjecture: for all positive s,t, every K_{s,t}-minor-free graph has choice number at most s+t-1.
